original:
Let $d\geq 2$ .
One can place $n^{d-1}$ non-attacking queens on $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^{d}$ if and only if all prime factors of $n$ exceed $2^{d}$ .
type: ∀ (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n], 1 < n → 2 ≤ d → ((∃ S, S.card = n ^ (d - 1) ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_14754_nonattacking S) ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n → 2 ^ d < p)
